name: Mole Sauce
siboNotes: Traditional mole contains onions, garlic, and sometimes dried fruits which can trigger SIBO symptoms. Use sparingly and consider homemade versions with FODMAP-friendly ingredients.
preparationTips: Make homemade mole using garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Replace onions with green parts of scallions for flavor
Choose mole varieties with minimal dried fruit content
Start with small amounts to test individual tolerance
alternatives: Homemade low-FODMAP chocolate sauce with cocoa and maple syrup
Chipotle sauce made with tomatoes and spices
Enchilada sauce without onion and garlic
Simple tomato-based Mexican sauce with cumin and paprika
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants from chocolate and chiles
Contains healthy fats from nuts and seeds
Good source of magnesium and iron
